correctness.rationale: From the quadratic-residue adjacency rule there are exactly 26 independent triples and 6553 augmented faces. A predetermined seven-stage vertex matching gives 3275 disjoint ordinary face pairs and leaves only a vertex and a 5-simplex. The standalone exact checker topologically sorts the full oriented Hasse graph on all 6553 augmented faces and 39156 incidences, proving acyclicity, not just computing its Euler characteristic. By the discrete Morse CW theorem this gives a 0-cell and 5-cell, hence S^5 integrally. Complete signed simplicial Lefschetz sums over all 78 affine graph automorphisms give the stated degree-5 integral sign character. Independent mod-two boundary-rank calculation agrees, but does not substitute for the integral homotopy argument.

value.rationale: The exact integral homotopy and nontrivial integral affine homology character give a complete natural finite classification of the first richly symmetric Paley-13 total-three-cut example. The pure dimension-9 complex is only homotopy dimension 5, demonstrating substantial non-shellability. A specific sign action of the order-78 natural symmetry subgroup is extra topological structure invisible from the rank-one homology. Neither a trivial relabeling of the ordinary cut complex nor merely a Betti recomputation.
